# Extra scene source

[中文](README.zh-CN.md)

This directory contains unmodified files from EmbodiedSWE revision
`046f7bf48865f3d3b48e64614350777fb5d5d163`, used by the Extra tasks.
[source_manifest.json](source_manifest.json) lists original source paths.
The upstream [license](LICENSE) is retained.

Runtime models reside in `assets/objects/<name>/`
and scenes in `assets/scenes/<name>/`. Install them through the [asset guide](../../README.md#assets).
